name: Freeze
desc: Freeze one enemy piece — it cannot move for 1 turn. Not king.

name: Shield
desc: Protect one of your pieces from capture for 1 turn.

name: Sniper
desc: Remove ANY piece from the board (even yours). Not king. No check.

name: Bad Sniper
desc: Remove one of YOUR own pieces (not king).

name: Promote
desc: Promote one of your pieces to a higher value type. Not king.

name: Demote
desc: Lower one of YOUR pieces to a weaker type. Not king.

name: Promote Him
desc: Promote enemy piece to higher value. Not king.

name: Demote Him
desc: Lower any piece (yours or enemy) to weaker type. Not king.

name: Teleport
desc: Move one of your pieces to any empty square. No check. Not king.

name: Jump
desc: Move one of your pieces to any empty square in YOUR half. Not king.

name: Double Move (Twin)
desc: Move TWO DIFFERENT pieces this turn. First must not cause check.

name: Double Move (Solo)
desc: Move the SAME piece TWICE this turn. First move must not cause check.

name: Swap Me
desc: Exchange positions of two of YOUR pieces. No check. No king.

name: Swap Us
desc: Swap one of YOUR pieces with one ENEMY piece. No check. No kings.

name: Swap Him
desc: Swap 2 of your opponent's pieces. No kings.

name: Borrow
desc: Control one enemy piece for 1 turn. Not king. No check.

name: Mind Control
desc: Permanently steal one enemy piece. Not king. No check.

name: Parasite
desc: Link your piece to enemy piece. If yours dies → theirs dies too.

name: Clone
desc: Copy one of your pieces onto an adjacent empty square. No check. Not king.

name: Lava Ground
desc: Mark 1 square. Any piece there next turn is destroyed (not king).

name: Fog Village
desc: 3×3 zone — opponent cannot see pieces inside.

name: Invisible
desc: One of your pieces becomes invisible for 1 round.

name: Unabomber
desc: Attach bomb to your piece. Next round it explodes destroying all adjacent pieces (kings immune). The piece itself is also destroyed.

name: Half Fuse
desc: Fuse two adjacent pieces (value ≤5 each) into one. Not king.

name: Full Fusion
desc: Merge two adjacent pieces into one with combined movement. Not king.

name: Fortress
desc: 2×2 zone — enemies cannot enter for 2 turns.

name: Reverse
desc: Undo opponent's last move.

name: Undo
desc: Cancel the last card your opponent played.

name: Mirror
desc: Copy opponent's last move with your equivalent piece, if legal.

name: Fake Piece
desc: Place an illusion piece. Opponent cannot tell if real until captured.

name: Black Hole
desc: Choose 2 squares. After 2 turns all adjacent pieces explode. Kings immune.

name: Small Sacrifice
desc: Sacrifice one or more of your pieces totaling 6+ points to draw 2 cards. Click pieces then empty square to confirm.

name: Big Sacrifice
desc: Sacrifice one or more of your pieces totaling 14+ points to draw 3 cards. Click pieces then empty square to confirm.

name: Gambler
desc: 50% steal a card from opponent. 50% give one of yours away.

name: Radar
desc: See all opponent's cards for 1 turn.

name: Cheater
desc: Engine reveals the best move to you.

name: Joker
desc: Choose any card from the full card pool — the Joker becomes it instantly.
